|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p3-92-A_Dark_Time_For_The_Rebellion.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-adarktimefortherebellion-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 Force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. OR ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 35)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “just drwn destiny” (typo as published) and writes “retrieve 1 force” and “Or ▲ Control”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1273_14">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drwn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. Or ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
